revisions.note: Revision 3 (bg-02 verification pass) - no second launcher was introduced: the existing pwa/nuxel-home PWA is extended, and the legacy framebuffer UI remains a non-competing recovery fallback. Completed this revision: (1) the launcher-cache authority is bumped v4-a33 -> v5-a33 in BOTH sw.js and manifest.nuxel.cache_version because js/qs.js and js/settings-store.js changed again - without the bump a bundle restored from the v4 cache keeps serving the old boot tile; (2) the behaviour the briQ asks to be covered by tests is now actually covered, against the REAL js/apps.js registry and js/app.js controller in a minimal DOM shell: activation (one .pwa-frame pointing at the registry url, no frame stacking, recents recorded), close-and-return-home (frame + close control removed; the logical home action closes overlays), search (the registry searchApps() is the matcher the search UI delegates to, asserted for name/category/case-insensitivity/empty/no-match/ranking), navigation (the manifest #app=<id> deeplink launches the real app; an unknown id is refused and opens no frame), and scrolling/viewport (the grid is the scrollable, momentum-scrolling, 4-column surface under viewport-fit=cover). PARITY GAP, recorded rather than glossed: the UTM Fedora 43 guest was unreachable (ssh ConnectTimeout), so no VM-vs-repo hash comparison table could be produced; the repo-side hash list and the UNAVAILABLE VM column are recorded in this revision evidence, and VM parity stays bg-11-vm-parity (ceiling VERIFIED_IN_VM_ONLY). On-glass parity remains NEEDS_OWNER_TEST.
